reason: The workshop needs to be recognizable, and the signwriter's paint suggests marking its front.
expectation: The paint will make the workshop front easier to find.

effect: The paint has no currently available combination, so I need another starting point for the workshop front.
reaction: I was surprised the obvious sign-painting pair did not work.
reason: Inspecting the front should reveal what it currently needs.
expectation: The inspection will identify an available way to prepare or mark the workshop entrance.

effect: The fobs opened the shutter, making the workshop accessible and potentially enabling further work on the front.
reaction: The automatic opening was useful, though I hadn't expected the fobs to be the first step.
reason: Now that the shutter is open, I suspect the paint may be usable to mark the workshop.
expectation: The paint will add a visible workshop sign or marking.

effect: Opening the shutter made the paint usable, and the workshop now has a freshly lettered sign.
reaction: The added “AND TODAY” is a nice touch.
reason: The retired address display could help people find the newly signed workshop.
expectation: The display will add address information to the workshop front.

effect: The address display needed the local controller first; it now shows the workshop's address and a request-desk call button.
reaction: The automatic setup was helpful, and its limited claim about Meridian is clear.
reason: The configured display and lettered workshop appear ready to be brought together so people can find and contact it.
expectation: The display will complete the workshop's visible, usable front.

effect: The display completed the workshop entrance and the first goal; the remaining goal is to give the night shift a reason to linger.
reaction: It is satisfying to see the local address help a rider find the workshop.
reason: The hot broth and breakfast noodles look like complementary ingredients for a meal for the shift.
expectation: The noodles will go into the broth to make breakfast.

effect: The broth and noodles made breakfast, completing the remaining goal and the chapter.
reaction: A shared meal is a warm, fitting conclusion to the night shift.

mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the local display to the workshop was satisfying: a Tin Row rider could actually find it without a paid address lookup.

leastWorthwhile.text: The initial attempt to paint the front was frustrating because the apparently obvious pairing was unavailable until the shutter was opened.

surprise.text: I didn't expect the residents' fobs to be the first step toward painting the workshop, or the address display to need the controller before installation.

arbitrary.text: The paint being unusable before the shutter was opened felt somewhat arbitrary, even though the later result identifies the sign as being on the old workshop front.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: seeing the locally maintained address help a neighbor arrive, followed by the shared breakfast, made the infrastructure work feel connected to people's lives.
